title: Water Damage Mitigation Service Tiers and Their Entry Gates
content:
## Tier definitions — Water Damage Mitigation

The tier of a water job is fixed at dispatch from the water category and the affected area mapped on arrival, using each tier's entry gate: the water category selects Clean, Gray or Black Water Mitigation, and an affected area at or above the Large Loss threshold selects the Large Loss tier of that category. The tier stays fixed for the life of the job; when the water category is reassessed after dispatch (for example clean water that has stood long enough to degrade), the job is not repriced, and on an insurance-funded job the difference in scope is pursued as a supplement on the claim file. The funding source is insurance claim only when the job is linked to a claim file of the same customer for the same loss date, and self-pay otherwise.

## Entry gates
| Tier | IICRC water category | Affected area mapped on arrival |
|---|---|---|
| Clean Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | Category 1 | 1 to 1999 sq ft |
| Clean Water Mitigation - Large Loss | Category 1 | 2000 sq ft or more |
| Gray Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | Category 2 | 1 to 1999 sq ft |
| Gray Water Mitigation - Large Loss | Category 2 | 2000 sq ft or more |
| Black Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | Category 3 | 1 to 1999 sq ft |
| Black Water Mitigation - Large Loss | Category 3 | 2000 sq ft or more |

The Large Loss threshold is therefore 2000 square feet of affected area: an area of exactly 2000 square feet is at the threshold and selects the Large Loss tier, while 1999 square feet selects the Standard Loss tier.

## Points of judgement
- **When is the tier fixed?** At dispatch, from the category and the area mapped on arrival.
- **Does a later reassessment of the category change the tier?** No. The job is not repriced; on an insurance-funded job the difference in scope is pursued as a supplement on the claim file.
- **When is a job insurance-funded?** Only when it is linked to a claim file of the same customer for the same loss date. A job with no such claim file is self-pay.

## Illustration (hypothetical)
A crew maps 2400 square feet of affected area from a dishwasher discharge assessed as Category 2. The job is held at Gray Water Mitigation - Large Loss for its whole life, even if the water is later reassessed.
